title: FinalizeDeliveryRequest
description: Finalizes one prepared attempt. Finalized and sent timestamps come from the C++ Clock; Kotlin supplies only the system outcome. timezone is an additive optional wire field for compatibility with existing Event, Ring, and ordinary Recovery callers. After loading the prepared attempt, C++ treats timezone as semantically required when the attempt targets an Anniversary Reminder or has kind=anniversary_catch_up. For a ring attempt, outcome=sent is permitted only after the foreground control notification is visible and at least one of sound or vibration has actually started.

timezone.description: Current device IANA timezone. Optional at the shared wire boundary, but semantically required for Anniversary Reminder and anniversary_catch_up attempts after C++ loads the prepared attempt. Explicit null is invalid.
